## Verification Complete

I reviewed the walkthrough run report and examined the codebase to produce the release verdict in REVIEW.md.

**What I verified:**
- ✓ Walkthrough test passed (1/1 expected behaviors matched, 0 unexpected deviations)
- ✓ Server implements structured logging with request-id propagation  
- ✓ Health check endpoint present
- ✗ Implementation is incomplete relative to specification:
  - Spec requires sign-in, add-note form, POST endpoint, error handling, loading states
  - Code only provides read-only GET /notes
  - No client-side JavaScript visible despite HTML skeleton
  - No auth despite spec requirement
  - No input validation (violates trust boundary policy)
- ✗ Minimal test coverage (only module-load test, no functional tests)
- ✗ Documentation inconsistencies (PRODUCT.md/OPERATIONS.md reference OKRs; implementation is ward notes)
- ✗ In-memory storage only—data lost on restart

The verdict recommends **not releasing** due to scope gaps, missing auth/validation, and incomplete implementation of the specified feature set. The passed walkthrough indicates the read-only core works, but the product requires the missing features and broader test coverage before production use.
